scope: Offline illustrative cases; not representative samples or causal tests.
quality_rule: Restrict each rule's pool to clear-quality queries if nonempty; otherwise disclose fallback.
extreme_case_tie_rule: Ascending full query ID after requested metric ordering.
text_retention: Complete query, generation, saved answer, evidence and provenance. Top100 rank identities/scores; winning-chunk text for top10 and accepted positives within100.

cases.selection_rule: Among Ten-hit/Tde-miss at 10, minimize Tde-minus-Ten nDCG@10; break ties by query ID.
cases.fallback_if_no_clear: Use all quality statuses, retaining the same rule.

cases.selection_rule: Among Tde-hit/Ten-miss at 10, maximize Tde-minus-Ten nDCG@10; break ties by query ID.
cases.fallback_if_no_clear: Use all quality statuses, retaining the same rule.

cases.selection_rule: Among both-hit at 10, maximize Tde-minus-Ten relevant-version count, then nDCG@10; break ties by query ID.
cases.fallback_if_no_clear: Use all quality statuses, retaining the same rule.

cases.selection_rule: Among both-hit at 10 with equal version count and absolute nDCG delta <=1e-12, sort query IDs and select using NumPy default_rng(42).integers(n).
cases.fallback_if_no_clear: Use all quality statuses, retaining the same rule.

cases.selection_rule: For BGE-M3 mixed search, maximize English-HyDE minus English-translation nDCG@10; break ties by query ID.
cases.fallback_if_no_clear: Use all quality statuses, retaining the same rule.
